title: AI Image Upscaler
description: Enlarge photos, logos, documents, and illustrations up to 4x cleanly using on-device Lanczos-3 pixel matrices. Fully offline & client-side.
dropDescription: or click to select files. Supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP formats.
localProcessing: Processed fully local in-browser. Zero server limits.
triggerProcessing: Click the processing buttons on the right side panel to trigger the upscaling calculations.
photoDescription: Soft-balanced contours; ideal for portraits and landscapes.
logoDescription: Geometric lines restoration + alpha transparency protection.
documentDescription: Heavy contour highlight to make low-res scans legible.
illustrationDescription: Illustration color preserving with smoothed pixel edges.
selectFiles: Select or drop image files to activate the upscale processing settings.
privacyDescription: Runs fully client-side on-device with zero cloud server communication. Processing occurs locally, supporting safe data storage sandbox containment, zero infrastructure fees, and works off-grid.
